prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean spray (airbrush/sunless) tanning or UV tanning with beds? And what part of Columbus are you in (zip code or neighborhood) — that will let me recommend the best nearby options.

Meanwhile, here are quick tips to find the “best” salon for your needs:
- Choose by type: spray tanning technicians give more natural, even results and are safer than UV beds. If you want a tan without UV exposure, look for professional airbrush or booth spray services.
- Check recent reviews (Google/Google Maps, Yelp) and photos from customers — focus on salons with many recent 4–5 star reviews.
- Ask about products and equipment: reputable spray salons use professional DHA solutions (ask about shade options and brands); UV salons should disclose bed age and bulb type.
- Hygiene and professionalism: clean facilities, disposable or sanitized gowns, and trained technicians who do a patch test and give prep/aftercare instructions.
- Pricing and packages: good salons offer transparent pricing, package deals, and follow-up touch-ups if needed.
- Safety: avoid frequent UV tanning (skin cancer risk). If you use beds, limit sessions, follow recommended intervals, and consult your doctor if you have skin concerns.

If you tell me spray vs UV and your neighborhood (or allow me to use a ZIP code), I’ll give 3–5 specific, highly rated salons in Columbus and what makes each one stand out.
